text:
🗳️ First provisional results from the 2026 local elections are in, with about a quarter of voting districts counted.

National (proportional ballot, 6,015 of 23,696 districts): ANC 32.2%, DA 28.6%, MK 6.2%. MK leads in KwaZulu-Natal with about a third of the vote.

The metros so far:
🏙️ Johannesburg: DA 40.3%, ANC 16.8%, ActionSA 15.5%
🏛️ Tshwane: ActionSA 29.0%, ANC 28.1%, DA 19.3%. A three-way race.
🌊 Cape Town: DA 62.8% (16% of districts counted)
🌅 Nelson Mandela Bay: DA leads
⏳ eThekwini: no results yet

Why it matters for your pocket: where no party wins more than half the seats, councils are run by coalitions. Those deals decide who sets your property rates, water and electricity tariffs and service budgets for the next five years.

These numbers will move: Gauteng and KwaZulu-Natal are still mostly uncounted. The IEC plans to announce the official results on Sunday, 8 November. Follow the live count at results.elections.org.za

Which metro are you watching? 👇
